method: one tall body view per image, front calibrated first then side/rear

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One full-body FRONT VIEW reference drawing of the same KING CORE BODY, tall PORTRAIT 2:3 composition. Image 1: approved CORE BODY, authority for body design and TALL proportions. Image 2: approved NORMAL HEAD with red midline fin, authority for head only. Do not use any prior R10 three-view boards.
CRITICAL HUMAN CORRECTION: the rejected R10 turnaround made the robot short and stocky. Restore the TALL ADULT HEROIC body from the approved R7 reference. Crown, skull and facial volumes stay normally tall; do not achieve height by shrinking or flattening the head. Main body below the neck has a visibly narrow waist, long exposed ivory THIGHS as well as long shins, and strong boots. Do not let skirt armor swallow the thighs. Excluding crown horns, skull-top to soles should read about 8 to 8.5 normal head heights. Hip-axis to floor is roughly 58-60 percent of skull-top-to-floor. Shoulder armor spans roughly 3.8 normal head heights, excluding wings. These are authoring guides for restoring the selected source, not new in-universe dimensions. Keep the normal chest and pelvis volumes; do not lengthen only the lower legs. Pose erect, knees almost straight, feet only moderately separated, no squat, no bent fighting stance.
Draw exactly ONE complete upright robot, true frontal, symmetric anatomical pose. Entire gold horn tips and soles visible with 5% margin. Arms relaxed slightly clear of waist, two normal black articulated hands. Navy torso and shoulder plates with ivory/gold borders, twin GOLD rectangular chest louvres and champion emblem, red abdomen, ivory pelvis and thighs, navy/ivory knees and long shin armor, gold circular joints, broad navy boots with gold toe caps. Preserve all R7 shapes, panel placement and palette. No added backpack, wings, cannons, drill, shield, missile pods or boosters.
Head uses Image 2 normal face: visible subtle mouth line, ivory jaw, red chin, gold cheek frames and gold round ears. Exact FIVE gold crown pieces, one thick upward curving center horn, two long inner antennae and two shorter outer antennae. One red sagittal fin BEHIND the gold crown, completely occluded in front. Do not show extra red ears/antennae. Head must not look squashed.
Clean mature Japanese cel mechanical design, clear broad planes, crisp outlines, restrained highlights. Plain warm white background, no ground wash, no labels, no text, no extra figures, no inset. Prioritize tall silhouette over filling width. The robot must look like the long-legged approved source viewed from the front.

Use case: stylized-concept. One full-body FRONT VIEW of FULL EQUIPMENT KING, SQUARE canvas for wide equipment, no other view. Image 1 approved CORE = anatomical shape, leg lengths, normally tall skull and proportions. Image 2 approved FULL = exact armor and weapon inventory. Image 3 approved CLOSED MASK + RED FIN = exact head face state. Do not use rejected R10 turnaround as a reference.
CRITICAL HUMAN CORRECTION: the rejected R10 turnaround made the robot short and stocky. Restore the TALL ADULT HEROIC body from the approved R7 reference. Crown, skull and facial volumes stay normally tall; do not achieve height by shrinking or flattening the head. Main body below the neck has a visibly narrow waist, long exposed ivory THIGHS as well as long shins, and strong boots. Do not let skirt armor swallow the thighs. Excluding crown horns, skull-top to soles should read about 8 to 8.5 normal head heights. Hip-axis to floor is roughly 58-60 percent of skull-top-to-floor. Shoulder armor spans roughly 3.8 normal head heights, excluding wings. These are authoring guides for restoring the selected source, not new in-universe dimensions. Keep the normal chest and pelvis volumes; do not lengthen only the lower legs. Pose erect, knees almost straight, feet only moderately separated, no squat, no bent fighting stance.
The FULL EQUIPMENT is built ON THE SAME LONG-LEGGED CORE, not a shorter body. Reproduce the source machine's substantial stacked armor and overarmed champion identity while keeping an obvious long adult leg line. Long ivory thighs must remain visible between pelvis skirts and knees. Long shins connect to broad navy gold-toed boots. Keep body skull-top-to-floor about 8.5 normal head heights EXCLUDING crown; face and helmet normal size. Do not thicken or broaden torso, hips, thighs or feet beyond Image 2.
Standing true FRONT, upright and knees nearly straight. All equipment tips, drill point and feet included with margins; permit plenty of canvas WIDTH for wings without shortening body. Anatomical RIGHT drill is on VIEWER LEFT; anatomical LEFT single decorated ivory/navy/gold shield is on VIEWER RIGHT. Exactly TWO primary rectangular shoulder/back cannons, black muzzle openings facing viewer. Keep the existing bilateral fans of layered navy/ivory blades with red tips, same separate round pivots and small cylindrical engines under wings. Exactly TWO long low booster nacelles flank the back lower legs, not extra arms. Exactly FOUR external leg launcher pods, one per outer thigh and outer calf, each with THREE vertically stacked round apertures as clearly visible in approved Image 2. Do not copy the two-hole drift from R10.
Copy paired gold chest louvres, golden champion chest emblem, red abdomen, separate skirt pieces, all reference navy/ivory/gold/red armor blocks.
Head: use EXACT CLOSED BATTLE MASK in image 3, broad ivory faceted two halves covering nose and mouth with one vertical ridge/seam, gold cheek vent frames, red chin latch. NO normal nose point or mouth line. Keep pale eyes. Gold crown has FIVE components with thick curved UPWARD center horn and two mirrored pairs. Single red sagittal fin lies behind center horn and is occluded in frontal view.
Clean crisp Japanese cel linework and two-tone broad plane shading matching references; warm white background, no labels, no text, no perspective 3/4 view, no crouch, no extra figure or diagram. Priority is faithful tall body with source equipment.
